reviewPolicy: Manual links require an explicit OSM reference, preserved source names, a review explanation, and official-map provenance. Ambiguous map-version conflicts remain excluded.

effectiveClassificationPolicy.presentationLabel: Most difficult · experts only · double black diamond
effectiveClassificationPolicy.reviewExplanation: Heavenly's official current winter map marks both Mott and Killebrew Canyons as double-black, experts-only gated terrain. Flurra preserves each run's map-derived source difficulty separately, while the effective classification communicates the controlling area access restriction anywhere the run is presented to users. Shared approach terrain is excluded.

officialMap.use: Human review of names, difficulty symbols, area restrictions, and organizational placement only; never geographic geometry.
